title: region-tiling-gpu-matrix-and-cost-model-2025
summary: Working spreadsheet-style planning sheet that tiles expected workload across regions and GPU families. Includes throughput assumptions, a small sample matrix for three regions, sensitivity scenarios, and a recommended BOM snapshot for an initial private/VPC deployment.
content:
Sheet sections:

1) Purpose
Quickly estimate hardware counts and CAPEX for a three-region private deployment by mapping expected QPS/seq-length workload into GPU shards using per-GPU sustained throughput assumptions and utilization targets. This is intentionally conservative for initial procurement (adds 15% spare nodes and 20% headroom for burst).

2) Key assumptions (editable)
- Target P50 latency SLO: 120ms for interactive text gen flows
- Tokens per request: 40 (avg)
- Model family: mix of open LlamaX-70B and optimized 30B variants
- Batch efficiency baseline: 0.65 (continuous batching + microburst inefficiency)
- GPU throughput (sustained tokens/sec) baseline: A100-80GB: 160k t/s, H100-80GB: 230k t/s, L40-48GB: 90k t/s
- CPU and network overhead: 10% added to node cost and headroom
- Rack overhead per node: 5% of CAPEX
- Spare nodes: 15% of peak nodes (rounded up)

3) Region tiling matrix (sample rows)
Header: Region | Target QPS | Avg seq len | Tokens/sec demand | Model variant | Preferred GPU | GPUs/shard | Estimated shards | GPUs total (raw) | Utilization target | Peak nodes needed | Spare nodes | Capex per node (USD) | Total CAPEX | Notes
Row1: us-west | 450 QPS | 40 | 18,000 t/s | llmx-70b-opt | H100-80GB | 2 | 4 | 0.72 | 6 | 1 | 120,000 | 840,000 | low-latency market, prefer H100 for perf-density
Row2: eu-central | 200 QPS | 45 | 9,000 t/s | llmx-30b | A100-80GB | 1 | 2 | 0.60 | 4 | 1 | 95,000 | 475,000 | higher uptime SLA, lower QPS
Row3: apac-north | 120 QPS | 35 | 4,200 t/s | llmx-30b-quant | L40-48GB | 1 | 1 | 0.50 | 2 | 1 | 68,000 | 204,000 | cost-sensitive region, heavier quantization

Notes on calculations:
- Tokens/sec demand = QPS * avg_seq_len
- GPUs needed raw = ceil( Tokens/sec demand / (gpu_throughput * batch_efficiency / GPUs_per_shard) )
- Peak nodes needed = ceil( GPUs total / gpus_per_node ) where gpus_per_node is assumed 8 for H100/A100, 4 for L40 by default
- Spare nodes = ceil( Peak nodes * 0.15 )
- Total CAPEX = (Peak nodes + Spare nodes) * Capex per node * (1 + rack_overhead)

4) Default hardware catalog (editable)
A100-80GB | Sustained 160000 t/s | GPUs per node: 8 | Capex per node: 95,000
H100-80GB | Sustained 230000 t/s | GPUs per node: 8 | Capex per node: 120,000
L40-48GB  | Sustained 90000  t/s | GPUs per node: 4 | Capex per node: 68,000

5) Sensitivity scenarios (quick evals)
- High-utilization (0.85 target): reduces nodes but increases risk of tail latency. Use only for non-critical workloads.
- Conservative (0.55 target): add ~25-30% nodes vs baseline; recommended for initial launch in each region.
- Burst-ready (extra 25% buffer on top of spare nodes): recommended for holiday/marketing spikes.

6) Quick procurement snapshot (recommended initial order)
- US-West: 6 peak nodes (H100, 8x) + 1 spare = 7 nodes -> 7 * 120k = 840k (rack overhead included in per-node capex above)
- EU-Central: 4 peak nodes (A100, 8x) + 1 spare = 5 nodes -> 5 * 95k = 475k
- APAC-North: 2 peak nodes (L40, 4x) + 1 spare = 3 nodes -> 3 * 68k = 204k
- Global initial CAPEX = 1,519,000 USD

7) Operational notes and TODOs
- Validate throughput numbers with serving-runtime team microbenchmarks (link to perf matrix).
- Confirm power and PDU capacity with customer DC for H100 racks (early check).
- Add network egress costing per region and map to sales pricing rules.
- Run a 2-week stress run with canary traffic to validate utilization and latency SLOs before final purchase order.

8) Quick change log
- 2025-03-12 created (S. Ramos)
- 2025-03-20 updated throughput numbers after initial microbench (E. Park)
- 2025-04-02 added procurement snapshot and spare calculation (P. Desai)

9) Appendix: compact formula cheat-sheet
- tokens_per_sec = QPS * avg_seq_len
- effective_gpu_throughput = baseline_throughput * batch_efficiency
- gpus_needed = ceil( tokens_per_sec / effective_gpu_throughput ) * shard_multiplier (if using model sharding)
- nodes_needed = ceil( gpus_needed / gpus_per_node )
- spares = ceil( nodes_needed * spare_ratio )

End of sheet.

Editable fields highlighted as uppercase in the sheet when ported to real workbook: QPS, AVG_SEQ_LEN, MODEL_VARIANT, PREFERRED_GPU, BATCH_EFFICIENCY, SPARE_RATIO, CAPEX_PER_NODE, GPUS_PER_NODE, BASELINE_THROUGHPUT.
